parsed_json.up: Select approved phase-4 drugs indicated for cancer. Return molecule ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles), EFO identifier (indication_curie), indication label (indication_label), and max phase for indication (max_phase_for_ind). Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno, then INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno for structures. Filter molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4 and drug_indication.efo_term or mesh_heading containing 'cancer' (case-insensitive). Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
